entradas.menu: "When you asked me to fix our healthcare system, I took responsibility and delivered the best results in four years' time."

entradas.text: "And most importantly, I thank *you* for supporting me through these difficult years."
entradas.menu: "And most importantly, I thank *you* for supporting me through these difficult years."

entradas.text: "And my greatest thanks goes out to all of you who came here today. You are the backbone of this campaign. Your noise is shaking the whole country!"
entradas.menu: "And my greatest thanks goes out to all of you who came here today. You are the backbone of this campaign. Your noise is shaking the whole country!"

entradas.text: "I must also thank every one of our citizens who resisted and fought with us."
entradas.menu: "I must also thank every one of our citizens who resisted and fought with us."

entradas.text: "As I promised four years ago, I made healthcare the focus of my administration and greatly expanded our services to the Sordish people."
entradas.menu: "As I promised four years ago, I made healthcare the focus of my administration and greatly expanded our services to the Sordish people."

entradas.text: I had to pause and had a few sips of water before continuing.
"Unfortunately, most of my term saw a period of emergency. But I had to take action, and it proved to be justified."
entradas.menu: "Unfortunately, most of my term saw a period of emergency. But I had to take action, and it proved to be justified."

entradas.text: "Four years ago, you and I began a journey together. We came together to bring prosperity to this glorious nation."
entradas.menu: "Four years ago, you and I began a journey together. We came together to bring prosperity to this glorious nation."

entradas.text: "We completed one of the biggest infrastructure projects in Sordland's history, which led to rapid economic development."
entradas.menu: "We completed one of the biggest infrastructure projects in Sordland's history, which led to rapid economic development."

entradas.text: "Since 1954, Sords have been given cliffs to climb, and found the tenacity to climb them. Now, we can see the valley below."
entradas.menu: "Since 1954, Sords have been given cliffs to climb, and found the tenacity to climb them. Now, we can see the valley below."

entradas.text: "You once protested our corrupt political establishment and you elected me to fight for you. To finally put Sordland first."
entradas.menu: "You once protested our corrupt political establishment and you elected me to fight for you. To finally put Sordland first."

entradas.text: "With the power you entrusted upon us, my administration fought to serve your interests alone."
entradas.menu: "With the power you entrusted upon us, my administration fought to serve your interests alone."

entradas.text: "Our government showed this nation steady, consistent and principled leadership with a clear and positive plan."
entradas.menu: "Our government showed this nation steady, consistent and principled leadership with a clear and positive plan."

entradas.text: "They did not believe in me when I first proposed our constitutional changes. I proved everyone wrong."
entradas.menu: "They did not believe in me when I first proposed our constitutional changes. I proved everyone wrong."

entradas.text: "Economic instability and depression plagued our country, but together, we overcame them."
entradas.menu: "Economic instability and depression plagued our country, but together, we overcame them."

entradas.text: "We managed to fix the recession and put it behind us. Now we can safely begin building our country back up again."
entradas.menu: "We managed to fix the recession and put it behind us. Now we can safely begin building our country back up again."

entradas.text: "By securing valuable international deals, we brought foreign investment and greatly increased our economic prosperity."
entradas.menu: "By securing valuable international deals, we brought foreign investment and greatly increased our economic prosperity."

entradas.text: "We were faced with existential threats from both inside and outside. But we eliminated all who threatened the integrity of our great nation."
entradas.menu: "We were faced with existential threats from both inside and outside. But we eliminated all who threatened the integrity of our great nation."

entradas.text: "Plagued by political turmoil in our first days in office, I took decisive action and brought stability to Sordland."
entradas.menu: "Plagued by political turmoil in our first days in office, I took decisive action and brought stability to Sordland."

entradas.text: "We improved rural treatment substantially by hiring health staff and upgrading equipment."
entradas.menu: "We improved rural treatment substantially by hiring health staff and upgrading equipment."

entradas.text: "We agreed to pay doctors, nurses and other health staff salaries commensurate with their value to our society."
entradas.menu: "We agreed to pay doctors, nurses and other health staff salaries commensurate with their value to our society."

entradas.text: "We built new hospitals where they were needed. Access to health became available for all."
entradas.menu: "We built new hospitals where they were needed. Access to health became available for all."

entradas.text: "Every one of my decisions was made to serve all Sordish citizens regardless of their ethnic background, religion or personal wealth."
entradas.menu: "Every one of my decisions was made to serve all Sordish citizens regardless of their ethnic background, religion or personal wealth."

entradas.text: "We took steps to protect our proud mother tongue and unified our education in the Sordish language."
entradas.menu: "We took steps to protect our proud mother tongue and unified our education in the Sordish language."

entradas.text: "Thanks to our policies, Sordish people can now enjoy more accessible and higher-quality healthcare."
entradas.menu: "Thanks to our policies, Sordish people can now enjoy more accessible and higher-quality healthcare."

entradas.text: I took a look at my supporters.
"Today, Sordish citizens enjoy more services and liberties than ever before."
entradas.menu: "Today, Sordish citizens enjoy more services and liberties than ever before."

entradas.text: "Today, every Sordish citizen is entitled to medicine for free!"
entradas.menu: "Today, every Sordish citizen is entitled to medicine for free!"

entradas.text: "Today, Sordish citizens enjoy a lower retirement age. By five years, no less..."
entradas.menu: "Today, Sordish citizens enjoy a lower retirement age. By five years, no less..."

entradas.text: "Sordland will stand with the CSP against Arcasian capitalism. With the power of the East, Sordland will be the dominant force in Eastern Merkopa."
entradas.menu: "Sordland will stand with the CSP against Arcasian capitalism. With the power of the East, Sordland will be the dominant force in Eastern Merkopa."

entradas.text: "As a new member of the CSP, we will be walking towards the future with more confident steps, together with our allies."
entradas.menu: "As a new member of the CSP, we will be walking towards the future with more confident steps, together with our allies."

entradas.text: "We integrated Sordland into the international arena. Now, Sordland is a member of the CSP."
entradas.menu: "We integrated Sordland into the international arena. Now, Sordland is a member of the CSP."

entradas.text: "We integrated Sordland into the international arena. Now, Sordland is a member of the ATO."
entradas.menu: "We integrated Sordland into the international arena. Now, Sordland is a member of the ATO."

entradas.text: "As a new member of the ATO, we will be walking towards the future with more confident steps, together with our allies."
entradas.menu: "As a new member of the ATO, we will be walking towards the future with more confident steps, together with our allies."

entradas.text: "Sordland will stand with the ATO against Malenyevism. With the power of the West, Sordland will be the dominant force in Eastern Merkopa."
entradas.menu: "Sordland will stand with the ATO against Malenyevism. With the power of the West, Sordland will be the dominant force in Eastern Merkopa."

entradas.text: "Today, the victims of Soll's purges can enjoy freedom once again."
entradas.menu: "Today, the victims of Soll's purges can enjoy freedom once again."

entradas.text: "We established a minimum wage and expanded rights and legal protection for our workers."
entradas.menu: "We established a minimum wage and expanded rights and legal protection for our workers."

entradas.text: "We built new rural schools and increased access to education."
entradas.menu: "We built new rural schools and increased access to education."

entradas.text: "We increased the salaries of teachers, principals and other education staff all around the country."
entradas.menu: "We increased the salaries of teachers, principals and other education staff all around the country."

entradas.text: "We improved rural education by purchasing new materials and upgrading old school equipment."
entradas.menu: "We improved rural education by purchasing new materials and upgrading old school equipment."

entradas.text: "We provided the Sordish people with higher-quality and more accessible education."
entradas.menu: "We provided the Sordish people with higher-quality and more accessible education."

entradas.text: "During our term, the traditional values of Sordland were protected and strengthened like never before."
entradas.menu: "During our term, the traditional values of Sordland were protected and strengthened like never before."

entradas.text: "As one of my last actions in office, I also made peace with our historical rival, Rumburg, managing the unthinkable."
entradas.menu: "As one of my last actions in office, I also made peace with our historical rival, Rumburg, managing the unthinkable."

entradas.text: "We taxed the elites of Sordland to balance the unequal share of wealth across our nation."
entradas.menu: "We taxed the elites of Sordland to balance the unequal share of wealth across our nation."

entradas.text: "We helped thousands of Sordish citizens with disabilities."
entradas.menu: "We helped thousands of Sordish citizens with disabilities."

entradas.text: "We helped millions of children and parents with our child benefit policy."
entradas.menu: "We helped millions of children and parents with our child benefit policy."

entradas.text: "We enacted policies that protect the interests of the Sordish people."
entradas.menu: "We enacted policies that protect the interests of the Sordish people."

entradas.text: "We unified our religious system and stopped militant groups from using religion to justify their violence."
entradas.menu: "We unified our religious system and stopped militant groups from using religion to justify their violence."

entradas.text: "That was not all. I stood at the precipice of a possible war with Rumburg. And rather than giving in to bloodshed, I began a peace process."
entradas.menu: "That was not all. I stood at the precipice of a possible war with Rumburg. And rather than giving in to bloodshed, I began a peace process."

entradas.text: "I defended Sordland's international interests and fought for peace in Eastern Merkopa."
entradas.menu: "I defended Sordland's international interests and fought for peace in Eastern Merkopa."

entradas.text: "During my term, the minorities of Sordland saw a great expansion of their political and social freedoms like they have never seen before."
entradas.menu: "During my term, the minorities of Sordland saw a great expansion of their political and social freedoms like they have never seen before."

entradas.text: The crowd was cheering: "President Rayne!"
"I gave the Bludish minority what they wanted for decades. An autonomous Bergia!"
entradas.menu: "I gave the Bludish minority what they wanted for decades. An autonomous Bergia!"

entradas.text: "I worked hard to expand the rights of our minorities. I formed a commission for Bludish rights and gave amnesty to all Bluds prosecuted for their ethnicity."
entradas.menu: "I worked hard to expand the rights of our minorities. I formed a commission for Bludish rights and gave amnesty to all Bluds prosecuted for their ethnicity."

entradas.text: "We brought free public transportation to all Sordish citizens!"
entradas.menu: "We brought free public transportation to all Sordish citizens!"

entradas.text: "I stood in the way of the ultranationalists and I crushed every bill that sought to undermine the Bludish people."
entradas.menu: "I stood in the way of the ultranationalists and I crushed every bill that sought to undermine the Bludish people."

entradas.text: "With increased control over the Central Bank, Sordland will be much swifter in taking action against economic turmoil."
entradas.menu: "With increased control over the Central Bank, Sordland will be much swifter in taking action against economic turmoil."

entradas.text: "We now give housing assistance to all Sordish citizens who need it. We're one step closer to eliminating homelessness!"
entradas.menu: "We now give housing assistance to all Sordish citizens who need it. We're one step closer to eliminating homelessness!"

entradas.text: "Today, every unemployed Sordish citizen is entitled to government assistance until they find a job."
entradas.menu: "Today, every unemployed Sordish citizen is entitled to government assistance until they find a job."

entradas.text: "I have always had the best interests of our people at heart, and I will continue to do so."
entradas.menu: "I have always had the best interests of our people at heart, and I will continue to do so."

entradas.text: "One of our historic achievements was to pay off all student debts. We erased it completely."
entradas.menu: "One of our historic achievements was to pay off all student debts. We erased it completely."

entradas.text: "In the face of foreign intervention and internal militants, we enacted new security laws and eliminated the threats."
entradas.menu: "In the face of foreign intervention and internal militants, we enacted new security laws and eliminated the threats."

entradas.text: "By establishing the Free Trade Commission, we ensured healthy competition, so that our citizens can buy higher-quality products for less."
entradas.menu: "By establishing the Free Trade Commission, we ensured healthy competition, so that our citizens can buy higher-quality products for less."

entradas.text: "I worked long and hard to ensure a brighter future for our country and our people."
entradas.menu: "I worked long and hard to ensure a brighter future for our country and our people."

entradas.text: "My term saw a great expansion of women's rights. Sordish women now finally have a voice."
entradas.menu: "My term saw a great expansion of women's rights. Sordish women now finally have a voice."

entradas.text: "In the last four years, the women of this country won a decades-long fight against the patriarchy."
entradas.menu: "In the last four years, the women of this country won a decades-long fight against the patriarchy."

entradas.text: "I de-segregated our education system which had deep roots in misogyny. Now every Sordish student is equal."
entradas.menu: "I de-segregated our education system which had deep roots in misogyny. Now every Sordish student is equal."

entradas.text: "I heard the pleas of our women and acted to represent their rights. I enacted laws that protect and liberate the women of this great nation."
entradas.menu: "I heard the pleas of our women and acted to represent their rights. I enacted laws that protect and liberate the women of this great nation."

entradas.text: "The truth is, I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."
entradas.menu: "The truth is, I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."

entradas.text: "The truth is, it is important to let go and allow new leadership to take the reigns."
entradas.menu: "The truth is, it is important to let go and allow new leadership to take the reigns."

entradas.text: "My dear citizens, this has been the greatest honor bestowed upon me as a fellow countryman."
entradas.menu: "My dear citizens, this has been the greatest honor bestowed upon me as a fellow countryman."

entradas.text: "At the end of my term, I will be ending my political career for personal reasons."
entradas.menu: "At the end of my term, I will be ending my political career for personal reasons."

entradas.text: "I have demonstrated that Sordland can improve as a society. Never lose hope, my fellow citizens."
entradas.menu: "I have demonstrated that Sordland can improve as a society. Never lose hope, my fellow citizens."

entradas.text: "I gave my heart and soul to serve this beautiful nation."
entradas.menu: "I gave my heart and soul to serve this beautiful nation."

entradas.text: "Our people are great and unique. We are destined for great things."
entradas.menu: "Our people are great and unique. We are destined for great things."

entradas.text: "I wish my successor the best of luck. For this is the greatest test of oneself."
entradas.menu: "I wish my successor the best of luck. For this is the greatest test of oneself."

entradas.text: "Sordland must walk the path of malenyevism to achieve true parity in society."
entradas.menu: "Sordland must walk the path of malenyevism to achieve true parity in society."

entradas.text: "Our nation should adopt the middle-ground solution of Valgslandian socialism to advance."
entradas.menu: "Our nation should adopt the middle-ground solution of Valgslandian socialism to advance."

entradas.text: "This country can combine strong elements of socialism and democracy to provide an alternative."
entradas.menu: "This country can combine strong elements of socialism and democracy to provide an alternative."

entradas.text: "I'd like to make a statement regarding the future of the country."
entradas.menu: "I'd like to make a statement regarding the future of the country."

entradas.text: "I'd like to conclude on that note."
entradas.menu: "I'd like to conclude on that note."

entradas.text: "The Colonel has provided a different and stronger path for the future of Sordland. One we should follow."
entradas.menu: "The Colonel has provided a different and stronger path for the future of Sordland. One we should follow."

entradas.text: "Our society, culture and the values Sords represent must be at the forefront of any governance."
entradas.menu: "Our society, culture and the values Sords represent must be at the forefront of any governance."

entradas.text: "Our country is great as is and there is little reason to make a drastic change to steer from this course."
entradas.menu: "Our country is great as is and there is little reason to make a drastic change to steer from this course."

entradas.text: "Sordland can enrich itself and be part of a new world order with an incentive-driven capitalist structure."
entradas.menu: "Sordland can enrich itself and be part of a new world order with an incentive-driven capitalist structure."

entradas.text: "Our nation must unlock the ambitions and potentials of individuals with material rewards to compete with the world."
entradas.menu: "Our nation must unlock the ambitions and potentials of individuals with material rewards to compete with the world."

entradas.text: "It is possible to find balance in the system of the west and still achieve high living standards for many."
entradas.menu: "It is possible to find balance in the system of the west and still achieve high living standards for many."

entradas.text: "Sordland should be a beacon of liberty and democracy. We can cherish our idealistic values."
entradas.menu: "Sordland should be a beacon of liberty and democracy. We can cherish our idealistic values."

entradas.text: "Our country should provide all types of freedoms and allow for safe transition of power regardless of who the people choose."
entradas.menu: "Our country should provide all types of freedoms and allow for safe transition of power regardless of who the people choose."

entradas.text: "Whichever way Sordland may evolve to, democracy must take a part in the form of government."
entradas.menu: "Whichever way Sordland may evolve to, democracy must take a part in the form of government."

entradas.text: "We wrote history when we celebrated our changes to the outdated Constitution of 1929."
entradas.menu: "We wrote history when we celebrated our changes to the outdated Constitution of 1929."

entradas.text: "We have amended our once-untouchable constitution and opened the way for further reforms."
